title: Derivation of Pulley Virtual Work Constraint
assumptions: Inextensible string of fixed length L
Massless string and massless frictionless pulleys
starting_principles: Virtual work done by internal tension vanishes

ordered_steps.explanation: Express the total length L of string as sum of segment lengths between pulleys and masses.
Differentiate length twice with respect to time, using dL/dt = 0 and d^2L/dt^2 = 0.
Since internal tension does zero net work on the massless string, virtual work by all tension forces vanishes.

limiting_cases: For fixed pulley with two masses, T a_1 + T a_2 = 0 yielding a_1 = -a_2
